mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals a monetary policy response to labor market weakness, which typically precedes a market correction as the economy enters a recessionary phase, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines > 0.5% during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, causing immediate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% during tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the past month reflects strong consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly payroll growth and rise in unemployment rate indicates a deteriorating labor market, causing immediate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
